author: mmusich
body:
#### PR description:

Add per-track TP matching info (matched, duplicate, tpPdgId, tpCharge, tpPt, tpEta, tpPhi) for `hltGeneralTracks`, mirroring what is already stored for hltPixelTrack. The value maps are built by `generalTrackAssoc` from the existing `tpToHltGeneralTrackAssociation` and written through an extension of the `hltGeneralTrack` table, run only in `NanoValTables` so the data-only flavours do not get zero-filled TP columns.

#### PR validation:

`runTheMatrix.py -l ph2_hlt` runs
